plain_english: By that effort the to-be-examined reality is got respectfully; since its freedom is everywhere unmade.
sanskrit_cite: labhate tatprayatnena parīkṣyaṃ tattvam ādarāt | yataḥ svatantratā tasya sarvatreyam akṛtrimā

plain_english: Not as impelled by wish-impulsion does it proceed; but, but — from self-power's touch the person becomes like that.
sanskrit_cite: na hīcchānodanasyāyam prerakatvena vartate | api tv ātmabalasparśāt puruṣas tatsamo bhavet

plain_english: Incapable of own purity, desiring things to be done — when agitation dissolves, then may there be the supreme state.
sanskrit_cite: nijāśuddhyāsamarthasya kartavyeṣv abhilāṣiṇaḥ | yadā kṣobhaḥ pralīyeta tadā syāt paramam padam

plain_english: Then his unmade nature, marked by knowing and doing; whatever he desires, he knows and does.
sanskrit_cite: tadāsyākṛtrimo dharmo jñatvakartṛtvalakṣaṇah | yatas tadepsitaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti ca karoti ca

plain_english: Regarding own nature as presiding, he abides as if smiling — whence his evil course?
sanskrit_cite: tam adhiṣṭhātṛbhāvena svabhāvam avalokayan | smayamāna ivāste yas tasyeyaṃ kusṛtiḥ kutaḥ

plain_english: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and there is no undelusion; since, from contact's application — then thus it was certain.
sanskrit_cite: nābhāvo bhāvyatām eti na ca tatrāsty amūḍhatā | yato 'bhiyogasaṃsparśāt tadāsid iti niścayah

plain_english: Hence that made thing is to be known as ever like deep sleep; but not thus being-remembered does that reality attain.
sanskrit_cite: atas tatkṛtrimaṃ jñeyaṃ sauṣuptapadavat sadā | na tv evaṃ smaryamāṇatvaṃ tat tattvam pratipadyate
